name: Termoso
subtitle: Free, private SSH client — self-hosted or Termoso Cloud
description: Termoso is a free, open-source SSH/SFTP client with end-to-end encrypted vaults, team sharing and no telemetry. This source publishes the iOS build straight from GitHub Releases; AltStore/SideStore sign it with your own Apple ID and refresh the 7-day profile automatically.

apps.name: Termoso
apps.subtitle: SSH · SFTP · encrypted vaults · teams
apps.localizedDescription:
SSH client built for people, not for data collection.

• Local encrypted vault with the master key in the iOS Keychain (this device only)
• Hosts, groups and tags shared with the desktop and Android clients
• Termoso Cloud or your own self-hosted server — or fully offline
• No telemetry, no accounts required, no paywalls

This is the first iOS increment: vaults, hosts and settings. Terminal, SFTP and port forwarding are next.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Termoso connects to SSH servers on your local network.
